headings.usage: Use for massive screen titles and critical numbers

body.usage: Use for chat messages, note content, and system status

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton, make the grid visible. No rounded corners.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px or 2px solid #0A0A0A on all functional containers

buttons.primary: Solid #0A0A0A background, White Mono text, 0px radius, 2px black border. Active state: background #002FA7.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, Black Mono text, 0px radius, 1px black border. Active state: background #F5F5F5.
buttons.danger: Solid #FF2A00 background, White Mono text, 0px radius.

inputs.text: Stark white background, 2px black bottom border (or full box), 0px radius. Mono font for input. Focus state: border turns #002FA7.
inputs.textarea: Like text input, but large box with 2px border all around. Used for notes ingestion.

chat_message.user: White bg, black text, full-width row with a stark 1px black border top. No chat bubbles. Raw text.
chat_message.ai: #F5F5F5 bg, black text, full-width row with 1px black border top. Includes sub-block for 'SOURCES [K]'.
chat_message.context_snippet: Wrapped in a 1px border block with a #E0E0E0 background. Text is strictly Mono and slightly smaller, prepended with a blue 'SRC //' label.

cards.style: Flat white background, 1px solid black border, no shadow. 0px radius. Used for notes list items.

navigation.bottom_tab: Hard 2px black top border. No icons, just bold uppercase mono text like [ CHAT ], [ NOTES ], [ SYS ]. Active tab gets #002FA7 text and a thick blue indicator.

interactions.feedback: Instant, brutalist active states. No soft ripples. Opacity drops or stark color inversions.
interactions.loading: ASCII art spinners, stark flashing blocks, or simple pulsing mono text '[ PROCESSING... ]'.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AAA compliance. Black on White, Blue on White.
accessibility.motion: Minimal to zero transitions. Instant state changes.

media.instructions: This is a strictly typographic, UI-centric application. Do not use placeholder images or avatars. Use typography and stark layout for visual weight.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `@expo-google-fonts/chivo` and `@expo-google-fonts/ibm-plex-mono` if possible, otherwise map to heavily weighted system fonts and system monospace.
Use standard React Native `View`, `TextInput`, and `FlatList` instead of web HTML. Utilize NativeWind or StyleSheet.
Implement the bottom tab navigator without icons, just pure monospace typography.
Ensure the Chat interface displays RAG retrieved snippets clearly below the AI's answer, styled as mechanical 'SOURCES'.
Notes ingestion screen should look like a raw terminal or code editor for pasting text.
Health/Settings screen should clearly display Ollama connection status using the success/danger colors.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid) formatted as kebab-case, role-based.
